newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: One-month Saudi t-bills steady, three and six rise.
newsitem.headline: One-month Saudi t-bills steady, three and six rise.

text.p: Yields were steady to higher at this week's offering of Saudi treasury bills worth three billion riyals to local banks by the Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency, a banker said on Monday.
The yield on 28-day bills were steady at 5.4217 percent, 91-day rose to 5.5869 percent from 5.5392 percent and 182-day increased to 5.7733 percent from 5.7324 percent.
One-month interbank rates were put at 5-9/16, 7/16 percent, three months were at 5-3/4, 5/8 percent and six months were at 5-15/16, 13/16 percent.
